title: Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd — Acquisition
publisher: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited
text: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition of Fatehgarh II Transmission Limited by POWERGRID under TBCB route.
